In [[3962 BBY]], former Jedi Master [[Dorjander Kace]] and a group of his followers called the [[Mandalorian Knights]] had a '''public trial''' on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. As the [[Mandalorian Wars]] raged throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], Kace, believing that the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] would win, defected to their side and attempted to provide them with very own Jedi Knights by kidnapping Jedi trainees from the [[Jedi Enclave]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. His plan was foiled by former Jedi Padawan [[Zayne Carrick]], and Kace was taken into custody by Jedi Master [[Zhar Lestin]]. During the process, Kace stood by his beliefs, proclaiming on the righteousness of his cause for nine hours.<ref name="KotOR War 5">[[Knights of the Old Republic: War 5|''Knights of the Old Republic: War'' 5]]</ref>
